title: How to set fixed valuation rate in Stock Entry purpose = Material Issue

posts.name: Peter John
posts.cooked:
Currently we are using Moving Average, but I want a specific item to set a fixed valuation rate and that will serve as the basic rate when creating Material Issue for that Item. Is there any setting that would fix my problem? Thank you

Best Regards,

Peter John

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @Pejay

The valuation mechanism controls outgoing quantities cost under stock ledger.

if incoming qty (purchase or manufacturing GRNs) are being recorded with different rates contributing for valuation rate which will be multiplied with outgoing qtys based on valuation mechanism either moving average or FIFO, fixed rate is not possible.

The valuation rate is like running total which depends upon incoming qty rates knowing the fact items are being control under warehouses for valuation purposes.

In simple words, valuation mechanism takes controls for all outgoing qtys where you can not set a fixed rate for an item if it has incoming qtys with different rates periodically.

posts.name: Jayaprakash J
posts.cooked:
You don’t want fixed valuation rates. Only if you purchase at a fixed rate then this could work under FIFO itself.

If you are purchasing for 100, but fixing the value of the item as 50, then it is fundamentally wrong.

Value of the item should be based on the actual purchase price. Either an average value or FIFO/LIFO basis. Otherwise you’re throwing the entire accounting system to the bin and using imaginary numbers to populate reports.
